name: feature.dealers.nodes
description: Dealer Network node pack — three READ nodes over the ctx.features.dealers surface: list dealers, list outlets, list deal registrations. PLUS one GOVERNED WRITE node: approve-registration, which enforces the run OWNER's host:dealers:manage scope (system runs denied) and is kept OUT of the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): the app's actual governed registration write rides the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: dealer-registration) — no built-in workflow ignites this node; it stays a composable catalog entry for a builder-authored chain. All nodes are role:"action", tenant+org-guarded (CTI-1); tenantId comes from the run scope, never node args.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Dealers: List Dealers
nodes.description: Lists an org's dealers over ctx.features.dealers.listDealers. Inputs: { orgId, territoryId?, status? }. Output: { dealers }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Dealers: List Outlets
nodes.description: Lists retail outlets over ctx.features.dealers.listOutlets. Inputs: { orgId, dealerId? }. Output: { outlets }.

nodes.label: Dealers: List Registrations
nodes.description: Lists partner deal registrations over ctx.features.dealers.listRegistrations. Inputs: { orgId, dealerId?, status? }. Output: { registrations }.

nodes.label: Dealers: Approve Registration
nodes.description: GOVERNED WRITE (ADR 0281 P3) — approves a pending deal registration over ctx.features.dealers.approveRegistration, stamping the run owner. Enforces host:dealers:manage against the RUN OWNER (system runs denied). Not in the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): no built-in workflow ignites this node — the app's actual governed write rides the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: dealer-registration); this node stays a composable catalog entry. Inputs: { orgId, regId }. Output: { success, registration }.
